blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Already out of contention, AEP Cabstars remained determined to end a losing spell and swept VNS Laticrete, 27-25, 25-19, 25-16, in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Saturday at Philsports Arena. Setter John Wayne orchestrated the balanced attack with 19 excellent sets for the Cabstars, who snapped a three-game losing skid to improve to 2-5, while four of his teammates scored in double figures, with Dave Lardizabal leading the way with 12 points. Leo Aringo had 11 points and six excellent receptions. Bem Bem Bautista tallied 11 points, 12 receptions, and five digs, while John Diwa also […]...
